## Description

Combines LSTM networks with multivariate self-exciting Hawkes point processes to model bursty order cancellations and forecast sudden liquidity dry-ups in limit order books.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency market making, flash crash risk management, limit order book liquidity monitoring.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Proprietary Trading Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, trade execution timestamps.

## Caveats

Recurrent Hawkes point process training requires high-performance C++/GPU acceleration for maximum likelihood estimation.
